Name: Stardew Valley Expanded
Author: FlashShifter
TagLine: Stardew Valley Expanded is a fanmade expansion for ConcernedApe's Stardew Valley. This mod adds 27 new NPCs, 50 locations, 270 character events, 1000 location messages, reimagined vanilla areas and world map, new music, new quests, and much more!
Description:
:::center
[﻿﻿](https://twitter.com/FlashShifter)﻿﻿﻿![](https://i.postimg.cc/4x3xq4sK/Stardew-Valley-Expanded-1920x1080.png)﻿
﻿

The world of Stardew Valley is awe-inspiring. Relationships, farming, fishing, adventuring...All made by just one person, who has given us the gift of so many memories with this game. But the problem with memories is that we'll never experience that world for the first time again.

I aim to give you, the player, that sense of adventure and unknown once more. Through this mod, I want to immerse you in the world ConcernedApe created.

-Flash



Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) stays as true to the source material as it can- from new areas and expanded dialogue and events, to the portraits for a brand new set of characters. My goal, as a modder hobbyist, is this: "Give the player the magical feeling they had when they first played Stardew Valley". To experience that magic as ConcernedApe intended, I recommend playing through vanilla Stardew Valley before jumping into SVE’s expanded world. For players who have already played Stardew Valley: think back to when you first walked into the Secret Woods, completed an elaborate quest, experienced Shane’s six heart event, or met Abigail for the first time. Stardew Valley is full of those inspired moments that enchant you and draw you into its world. By taking that world and expanding it, I hope to create more of those moments, so you can always find something new when you make your way back to the valley. Starting a new save file is required!
.

.

Manual installation of SVE is another option. There are two required frameworks that must be installed: [Content Patcher](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/470174-content-patcher) and [Farm Type Manager](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/598755-farm-type-manager-ftm)

﻿![](https://i.postimg.cc/9Q3KvJGv/New-NPCs.png)﻿

SVE adds dozens of new NPCs. These characters come with dynamic dialogue, schedules, back story, personalities, animations, events, and more. There's other characters still under development! The spoiler tab contains more information about them.

#### **NEW CHARACTERS**

!!!
**VICTOR**

![](https://i.postimg.cc/nzSJvnb7/Victor.png)﻿

Victor lives with his mother, Olivia. He recently graduated top of his class from a prestigious university with a Bachelors in Engineering. He isn’t sure what he wants to do with his life. Victor spends most of his days in the library, the park, gazing out at the ocean, working on his projects, repairing/building computers, and playing video/arcade games. He is close friends with Sophia, Sam, Sebastian, and Abigail.

.

**OLIVIA**

﻿﻿﻿![](https://i.postimg.cc/wTC9fxtQ/Olivia.png)﻿

Olivia lives in the big blue house next to Pierre’s store with her son, Victor. Their family is wealthy and previously lived in Zuzu City. They moved to Stardew Valley when Olivia cashed out her stocks at Joja. She used to be an accounting manager at Joja, and made a load of money via the stock market. She spends her days dining on exquisite food, sipping her expensive wine, walking around Pelican Town, doing yoga, and painting. She’s good friends with Caroline, Pierre, and Jodi.

.

**ANDY**

﻿![](https://i.postimg.cc/L4yXTMBx/Andy.png)﻿

Andy is the owner of Fairhaven Farm in Cindersap Forest. He doesn’t get along well with his neighbors or Lewis. He has never married, and has mostly lived a lonely live. He strictly supports Joja, buying all of his seeds, supplies, and food from their store. He is good friends with Morris, George, and Susan. His hobbies include foraging in the forest, drinking Grampleton wheat ale, and reading passages about Yoba.

.

**SUSAN**

﻿![](https://i.postimg.cc/43ZsG8QK/Susan.png)﻿

Susan is the owner of Emerald Farm at the railroad. Her farm specializes in juice and exporting 90% of shipments to provinces around the Ferngill Republic. She is good friends with Robin, Lewis, Andy, and folks in Grampleton. Her hobbies include crafting, traveling, cooking sweets, and taking care over her many plants.

.

**SOPHIA**

![](https://i.postimg.cc/yd8Kgk5s/Sophia.png)﻿

Owner of Blue Moon Vineyard. She loves anime, manga, and cosplay. She’s very shy and mostly keeps to herself. She’s good friends with Victor, Olivia, Gus, Haley, and Emily.

.

**MORRIS**

![](https://i.postimg.cc/28bz7L55/Morris.png)﻿

The manager of Joja Mart located in Pelican Town. He believes Joja will set a path of improvement to the Ferngill Republic - no matter the cost. Morris is a fully functional vanilla NPC: friend-able, new events, schedule, dialogue, and back story.

.

**MARLON**

![](https://i.postimg.cc/JhW4n7Mz/Marlon.png)﻿

The notorious monster hunter of Stardew Valley and leader of the Adventurer's Guild. Marlon is a fully functional vanilla NPC: friend-able, new events, schedule, dialogue, and back story.

.

**CLAIRE**

﻿![](https://i.postimg.cc/xTh1wyZH/Claire.png)﻿

Claire commutes to the valley to work at Joja Mart. She doesn't have any friends besides her co-worker, Martin. 

.

**MARTIN**

﻿![](https://i.postimg.cc/25FjBpSF/Martin.png)﻿

His mom and dad made him get a job to get work experience at Joja Mart. He's a faithful co-worker to Claire.
!!!

.

#### **SECRET CHARACTERS**

!!!
**MORGAN**

![](https://i.postimg.cc/Kz0ZJnL1/Morgan.png)﻿﻿

An apprentice assigned from the Ferngill Republic Ministry of Magic to Magnus Rasmodius at the start of year 3.

.

**APPLES**

﻿![](https://i.postimg.cc/PrPqVFST/Apples.png)﻿

A very friendly Junimo who loves eating starfruit. Apples becomes a NPC after players complete the Aurora Vineyard quest line.

.


**GUNTHER**

﻿![](https://i.postimg.cc/BnFn4PWz/Gunther.png)﻿

Pelican Town's curator and librarian. He hopes to make a ground breaking discovery one day! Gunther is unlocked after players donate 60 artifacts to the museum.

**LANCE**

﻿![](https://i.postimg.cc/Y9rr6X4c/Lance.png)﻿

Lance is a monster researcher hailing from The First Slash guild. He's also a talented combat mage. Players can unlock him as a new character once they beat the Volcano dungeon on Ginger Island.

**SCARLETT**

﻿![](https://i.postimg.cc/mg7B0xCf/Scarlett.png)﻿

Scarlett is Sophia's best friend. She lives in the Pondwood Suburbs with her papa in Grampleton. Players can unlock her as a social NPC once they finish Sophia's character arc and completed the community center/joja development form.
!!!

.

.

.

![](https://i.postimg.cc/C1v9X0NN/New-Character-Events.png)﻿﻿

Every character has a new event, most receiving multiple. SVE events aim to expand story of characters and the lore of the world. Players can visit the [Stardew Valley Expanded Wikipedia](https://stardew-valley-expanded.fandom.com/wiki/Stardew_Valley_Expanded_Wiki)﻿ for details on how to trigger the new events. SVE as of Version 1.15 adds over 270 new events.

.

.

.

![](https://i.postimg.cc/pXgMP2tc/Expanded-Joja-Story.png)﻿﻿

SVE features an expanded Joja storyline! What will the fate of Pelican Town be if you, the player, side with Joja and allow a takeover of the valley? 

.

.

.

![](https://i.postimg.cc/sxvbRLHR/New-Farm-Maps.png)﻿

SVE adds an additional two farm maps to choose from (optional).

 [Grandpa's Farm](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/880067-grandpas-farm)
The recommended farm map to choose when playing with Stardew Valley Expanded! Replaces the standard farm layout. Modestly sized farmland, tillable grass, multiple questlines, different landmark locations, shortcuts to surrounding areas, and secrets to discover. Grandpas Farm comes with a sandbox layout configuration for players wanting full control on map design.

 [Immersive Farm 2 Remastered](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/833727-immersive-farm-2-remastered)
A huge plot of land optimized for multiplayer or solo players looking for a challenge. Features tillable grass, a questline, and secrets. Comes with many configurations!

.

.

.

﻿![](https://i.postimg.cc/pX53Ggnf/New-Locations.png)﻿﻿

SVE adds 50 new locations, both interior and exterior maps. Some locations must be unlocked through progression and quests. 

.

.

.

![](https://i.postimg.cc/yNyMhc32/Location-Messages.png)﻿﻿

All maps, vanilla and new, interior and exterior, are filled with locational messages for you to discover and experience. There are over 800 throughout the world!

.

.

.

![](https://i.postimg.cc/mr3sdKJX/Configurations.png)﻿

A configuration file is generated within the [CP] Stardew Valley Expanded and [CP] Immersive Farm 2 Remastered folders when the game is ran once. Configurations can be toggled at will on already existing saves. The spoiler tab has detailed information on all possible configurations. Players can change the way they wish to experience their SVE play throughs!

.

#### **STARDEW VALLEY EXPANDED CONFIGURATIONS**

!!!

**Seasonal Edits**

Default = “True”

Adds leaves to all building roofs during fall and snow to many objects during winter (fences, stop signs, plants, etc). Automatically adjusts colors if players have Starblue Valley or Eemie recolors installed.

.

**Replace Default/Hardwood Fences**

Default = “True”

Replaces the standard and hardwood fences with the matching static fences found throughout exterior locations. Automatically adjusts colors if players have Starblue Valley or Eemie recolors installed.

.

**Immersive Shadows**

Default = "True"

Adds shadows to buildings and large objects in the world.

.

**Can Walk Over Beach Tidepools**

Default = "False"

Makes the tidepools at the beach traversable.

.

**Smaller Desert Map**

Default = "False"

Cuts the horizontal axis in about half. Shortens the bus trip to the desert.

.

**Remove Objects From Grandpas Shed**

Default = "False"

Once players complete the quest, they can opt in to remove all static objects from the interior.

.

**Balanced Crafting**

Default = “False”

Crafting requires more/different resources. Some craftables are easier to make. Recommended if players are using the “Automation” mod and/or IF2R to balance resource intake.

.

**Harder Building Construction**

Default = “False”

Constructing buildings cost more resources and money.

.

**Lower Profit Margins**

Default = “False”

Animal products, artisan goods, crops, and forage sell for 20% less.

.

**Stronger Monsters**

Default = “False”

Monsters receive a significant buff in damage dealt to players (double), with slight increases in HP. Shadow Brutes and Mummies have large HP and damage buffs.

.

**Older Sophia Portraits**

Default = “False”

Makes Sophia's portraits look older!

.

**Mature Events**

Default = "False”

Adds an additional 10 events that contain extremely serious topics, dark undertones, and moral ambiguity. If players wish to play SVE with these events, they must consent via toggling the configuration to “true”.
!!!

.

.

.

![](https://i.postimg.cc/PJ99fM0v/New-Fish.png)﻿﻿﻿

23 new fish are introduced in SVE! Details on where to catch them, difficulty, sale price, and more can be found on the [Stardew Valley Expanded Wiki](https://stardew-valley-expanded.fandom.com/wiki/Fish)

![](https://i.postimg.cc/FFCQnyC4/Custom-Forage.png)﻿

Immersive custom forage spawn locations throughout the world, in every map. Some forage are one time spawns and others spawn in specific areas. After playing for 2+ years, many spawns are buffed or will appear.

OtherFields.patchNotes:
SVE 1.15.11

SVE legendary fish now produce more roe in fish ponds and have pond colors.
Magic Wand relic is now physically handed to the player by Lance instead of appearing in a chest at his Highlands outpost.
Added internal context tags to various SVE objects for better mod compatibility.
Wizard no longer visits the player to start the Enchanted Grove questline on a festival day.
The Frontier Farm minecart quest will now always start the day after the boiler room bundle is completed.
Sophia's special order should now only appear once players have unlocked Ginger Island.
Reduced the cost and required resources to build the Winery (1,000,000g > 500,000g) (50 > 30 kegs), (30 > 25 iridium bars).
Increased the speed of the Golden Slime.
Adjusted some textures on the Pear Tree.
Legendary monsters are now immune to the Frog Trinket and Ice Rod.
Fixed Golden Slime's aggro range syntax. It will now see players up to 8 tiles away.
Fixed players waking up at Ginger Island if they passed out in the Diamond Cavern.
Fixed Lance's schedule sometimes glitching when walking to and from the Highlands.
Fixed Marlon walking through a boulder during the beginning of his 4 heart event.
Fixed Marlon liking Vegan Cone and Ice Cream Sundae.
Fixed Claire having an angry expression when wearing her Joja uniform during her 6 heart event.
Fixed Victor not returning home from the desert festival when married to the player.
Fixed Victor's event where he talks about the player dating his mother from triggering if players are dating him.
Fixed Victor's 10 heart event for farmhands that caused them to freeze.
Fixed Dwarf Dagger critical chance (1.2% > 12%).
Fixed Blue Discus being catchable at Fable Reef (not a salt water fish).
Fixed various dialogues for Apples when rooming with the player.
Fixed Poppy Seeds, Flour, Sugar, Oil, Vinegar, Rice, Grass Starter, and random wallpaper/floors missing from the Joja Mart shop.
Fixed incorrect Joja shop internal IDs.
Fixed Frontier Farm player icon tracking overwriting other farm map data.
Fixed a typo in Immersive Farm's Bus Stop warp data.
Fixed Immersive Farm's light debris configuration not working correctly.
Fixed many miscellaneous map tiling issues.
Fixed other small miscellaneous bugs.
Fixed typos.
